name: io.github.swoopeagle/oer-mcp
description: 35,000+ open-licensed K-12 content + released assessment chunks across math, science & social studies (OpenStax, IM, Khan, SBAC, NAEP, Regents, MCAS, AP FRQ), aligned to 300+ standards (CCSS, AP, state, C3).
title: OER MCP

environmentVariables.name: OER_CORE_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to oer_core.db (CC BY / public domain content). Downloaded by install.sh to ~/.oer-mcp/oer_core.db

environmentVariables.name: OER_ADDON_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to oer_ncsa.db (Khan Academy + OpenMiddle, CC BY-NC-SA). Optional add-on.

environmentVariables.name: OER_STATE_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to oer_state.db (NY Regents + MCAS, educational use). Optional add-on.

environmentVariables.name: OER_AP_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to oer_ap.db (AP free-response, © College Board, educational use). Optional add-on.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama base URL for semantic search (requires nomic-embed-text). Defaults to http://localhost:11434. Omit to use FTS5 keyword search only.
